title: fix(scripts): refuse a `-t` name filter that cannot match the title it spells (objectui#9660)
body:
Fixes #9660

Authored by the `domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat, session `session_01UanLVj6xvbS6puBCewLr8L` (https://claude.ai/code/session_01UanLVj6xvbS6puBCewLr8L).

Clause-②: no — no published surface moves. The diff is `scripts/vitest-invocation-guard.mjs` and its pin suite, nothing else. No package `src/`, no `exports`, no `.d.ts` member added, removed, renamed or retyped; `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` prints "no changeset is owed" for exactly that reason.

## 0. The documentation half was REMOVED from this branch, on the PM's instruction

The first push of this branch also added a 9-line bullet to `AGENTS.md §测试纪律`. It was removed in `7d5e9858c` because **`AGENTS.md` is a GOVERNED SURFACE** — the `agents-md` entry in `GOVERNED_SURFACES`, beside `docs/adr/**`, `.claude/**` and `skills/**` — so a pull request touching it needs an approved review from an authorized approver before it can go ready, and governed-surface work belongs to the **`domain:skills`** lane, not to this `domain:spec` card.

⛔ Not deleted silently. The prose is being filed as its own `domain:skills` card, **verbatim**, and it is reachable from this PR's own history at `3daed0c67`. It is also reproduced here so a reader of this page never has to go looking:

```
- **`-t` 是正则,不是字面量(objectui#9660)。** 本仓的 `describe` 名普遍以 `(objectui#NNNN)`
  结尾,整段复制粘贴进 `-t`,那对括号就成了捕获组 —— 一个测试都匹配不到,而「名字过滤零匹配」
  在 vitest 里算 **skipped、不算失败**:`Tests 22 skipped (22)` + **退出码 0**。文件过滤是匹配上
  了的,所以上一条的 `passWithNoTests` 在这里什么都管不到,屏幕上也没有任何 `0 tests matched`。
  于是「跑一下那条具名 pin 看过没过」得到的是一个**假绿**。正确写法两种:把元字符转义
  (`-t 'not prose \(objectui#7733\)'`),或者只取名字里一段**不含元字符的子串**
  (`-t 'are derived, not prose'`)。⛔ 别按退出码读结论 —— 读「passed 的计数不是 0」。
  这一形态现已由 `scripts/vitest-invocation-guard.mjs` 直接拒绝;⛔ 它今天拒绝哪些形态同样不写在这里,
  以 `scripts/__tests__/vitest-invocation-guard.test.ts` 为准。
```

After the removal, `AGENTS.md` is **byte-identical to the branch point** (`git hash-object AGENTS.md` equals `git rev-parse 2dbb49975:AGENTS.md`), and `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test scripts/vitest-invocation-guard.mjs scripts/__tests__/vitest-invocation-guard.test.ts` exits **0**: `✅ NOT GOVERNED — 2 path(s) checked against 5 governed surface(s); none matched.`

⭐ The mechanical half is the load-bearing rung and it stands without the prose: the guard REFUSES the vacuous spelling, so the false green is unspellable whether or not any document mentions it.

**On the `changeset-claim-re-read` gate that fired on the first push**: it named four pending entries (`6357-basechema-bind-declaration.md`, `6505-predicate-valued-gate-rules.md`, `7122-spec-17-3-0-parity-reconciliation.md`, `7714-lookup-draft-stays-client-side.md`) **only** because the diff touched `AGENTS.md`. Checked rather than skipped: all four cite `AGENTS.md` §4 for the node shape, for predicate-valued gate rules, and twice for the `minor`-rather-than-`major` version-alignment rule — the removed bullet was an addition in a different section and falsified none of them. With the hunk gone, no pending entry names any path in this diff.

---

## 1. Reproduced first, with a lit control

Instrument **DOMAIN**: `pnpm exec vitest run FILE -t PATTERN`, launched from the repo root.
Instrument **PREDICATE**: the exit code, and how many of that file's tests actually executed.
**Corpus** (both legs): `scripts/__tests__/body-dialect-census.test.ts`, whose `describe` title ends in a card reference the way this repo's titles do.

Both exit codes were captured to a file **before any pipe**, and both readings are from the tree at `2dbb49975`, before the repair.

| leg | `-t` argument | exit | what ran |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| DARK | `the population travels with the reading (objectui#9545)` | **0** | `Test Files 1 skipped (1)` · `Tests 22 skipped (22)` · `tests 0ms` |
| **LIT CONTROL** | `the population travels with the reading` | **0** | `Test Files 1 passed (1)` · `Tests 7 passed \| 15 skipped (22)` |

Same instrument, same corpus, same file filter; the only variable is the parenthesised card reference. The control is what makes the first row a reading rather than two zeros on one instrument.

`-t` is a **regex**. Pasted verbatim, `(objectui#9545)` becomes a capture group, so the pattern requires `reading objectui#9545` and the real title spells `reading (objectui#9545)` — no test matches. Vitest calls a name-filtered-out test **skipped**, not missing, so `passWithNoTests` never enters the picture: the FILE filter did match. Nothing on screen says `0 tests matched`. A seat checking "did the named pin pass?" sees exit 0 next to the file's own name.

## 2. The repair — and the rung it lands on

New verdict `unmatchable-name-pattern` in the existing guard. It refuses a `-t` / `--testNamePattern` value that **cannot match the plain text it appears to spell** — anchors dropped, `\x` collapsed to `x` — and prints the escaped spelling that does:

```
  -t 'the population travels with the reading \(objectui#9545\)'   # 原样匹配那个名字,元字符已转义
```

Measured after the repair, same corpus: the pasted form now exits **1** with the box above; the escaped form the message hands back exits **0** with `Tests 7 passed | 15 skipped (22)`; the plain substring still exits 0 with the same 7 passed.

**This lands on rung 3 — add a check — and the two higher rungs were not reachable.** Stated plainly rather than implied:

- **Rung 1, delete the construction that permits the error.** The construction has two halves and neither is ours to delete. `-t` is Vitest's own documented CLI contract, upstream, and this repo's timezone pin (`scripts/__tests__/vitest-timezone-pin-8366.test.ts`) spawns a child that depends on it. The other half is the parenthesised card reference in `describe` titles, which this repo's own citation convention asks for; a tree-wide rename would trade a live convention for an **incomplete** fix, because a title carrying `[`, `|` or `+` traps identically.
- **Rung 2, make the correct form the only spelling.** There is no repo-owned wrapper every named run passes through — `pnpm exec vitest run … -t …` is typed directly, by people and by agents. Any wrapper added here would be a *second* spelling, not the only one, unless the bare form is refused; and refusing it is rung 3. Rewriting argv at config load was considered and rejected: Vitest has already parsed the CLI by then, and commandment #6 bans that kind of magic.
- ⭐ **So it is rung 3 — but it REFUSES, it does not warn.** A warning would leave the false green spellable, which is the thing the card says not to settle for. After this change the vacuous spelling cannot produce a run at all.

The trigger is **static**, decided at config load before collection, which is the same choice the guard's own "Deliberately strict" section already argues for on the cwd arm: "collected zero" is the weaker signal, because a literal title with its metacharacters left live is the wrong command whether or not something else happens to match it.

⚠️ **Known, accepted false positive, stated rather than hidden**: a deliberately grouped regex such as `(a|b) renders` also cannot match its own literal text, so it is refused too. That is the same strictness the cwd arm already chose, and the message names the one escape hatch every other verdict names (`OBJECTUI_VITEST_GUARD=off`). No workflow, no `package.json` script and no gate in this tree passes `-t`; the only programmatic caller is the timezone pin, whose constant is metacharacter-free and is now pinned to stay allowed — read out of that file's source, not copied into the pin.

## 3. Ablation — the repair can fail

Mutation: `judgeNamePattern` made to answer `null` unconditionally, i.e. the tree as it was before the repair. Run from the **committed** state, proven on disk **before any result was read**, restored under a `trap` with `git checkout HEAD -- ABSOLUTE_PATH`.

```
HEAD_BLOB=a01f044cd8b78814091d2988db4d23687b1850f1
BEFORE_BLOB=a01f044cd8b78814091d2988db4d23687b1850f1 BEFORE_BYTES=32682
anchors before: removed=1 injected=0
anchors after:  removed=0 injected=1
AFTER_BLOB=695bca8b0af87232b643e0b27b283e9d40ca79aa AFTER_BYTES=32634 byte_delta=-48
ABLATED_PIN_EXIT=1        # Test Files 1 failed (1) / Tests 5 failed | 52 passed (57)
ABLATED_DARK_EXIT=0       # Test Files 1 skipped (1) / Tests 22 skipped (22)  <- the false green is back
RESTORED_BLOB=a01f044cd8b78814091d2988db4d23687b1850f1
GIT_DIFF_HEAD_FILES=0
ABLATION_COMPLETE
```

Restoration is proven twice, by blob equality against the HEAD blob **and** by an empty `git diff HEAD` — not by a `trap` having fired and not by an exit code. The script refuses an empty hash as FAILURE rather than reading it as "nothing to compare", and aborts if the pre-mutation blob is not already HEAD's.

Direction, declared before the run and observed after: **RED**, plus the original defect reappearing end to end. 5 of the 11 new cases fail under the mutation; the `'invalid'` arm sits before the mutated line and legitimately survives it, which is why it is 5 and not 11.

No build step is involved — the guard is loaded as `.mjs` by `vitest.config.mts` directly, so there is no `dist/` for a mutation to fail to reach.

## 4. The sibling cwd trap — does the same shape apply?

**Yes, and it is the shape used here.** objectui#3378 is refused by a static comparison at config load — Vitest's root against the repo root, one equality — and the guard's docstring records that the *weaker* trigger ("collects zero of its own files") was deliberately rejected. This arm is built the same way: a static predicate, at the same call site, refusing outright, inheriting the same wiring that already covers every entry point (the root config plus each `packages/PKG/vite.config.ts`). No new plumbing.

Two honest differences:

1. The cwd predicate is **exact** — one equality, no false positives. This one is a **conservative heuristic**: it fires only when a pattern provably cannot match its own literal reading, which is sound for the pasted-title case and over-fires on a deliberately grouped regex. That residual is why the escape-hatch line is in the message.
2. The cwd trap cannot be caught at runtime at all — the run looks green. This one *could* be, by a reporter that failed when a name filter matched zero tests. ⛔ Not taken: that changes how **every** run in this repo reports, which is the class this lane sent a PR back for today.

## 5. Stop conditions

- ⛔ No test weakened, skipped or quarantined. The demonstration is a mutation of the guard, reverted and proven reverted; 11 cases were added to the guard's pin file and none removed (`Tests 57 passed (57)` after).
- ⛔ No existing gate's counting or reporting changes. The new verdict is reachable only through a `-t` / `--testNamePattern` value, which nothing in `.github/workflows/`, no root script and no gate passes.
- The check runs **last** in `evaluateVitestInvocation`, pinned by a case asserting that `double-dash-args`, `package-cwd`, `missing-path-filter` and `subsumed-positional-filter` all keep their own codes when a vacuous `-t` rides along. This check only ever ADDS refusals.
- Serial constraint re-taken live against PR objectui#9724 both before the first edit and again before this push: it modifies `scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs` and `scripts/__tests__/check-doc-component-types.test.ts` only. The file-level intersection with this diff is **EMPTY**.

## 6. Gates — exit code captured to a file before any pipe

All re-run on the reduced diff, at `7d5e9858c`.

| gate | exit | printed verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/` | 0 | `Test Files 170 passed \| 2 skipped (172)` · `Tests 4974 passed \| 2 skipped (4976)` |
| `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/vitest-invocation-guard.test.ts` | 0 | `Test Files 1 passed (1)` · `Tests 57 passed (57)` |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | 0 | `✅ check-control-bytes: OK (scanned 7825 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary)` |
| `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | 0 | `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s), enforcement report-only -> exit 0` |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | 0 | `✅ No source or published contract of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed.` |
| `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test …` | 0 | `✅ NOT GOVERNED — 2 path(s) checked against 5 governed surface(s); none matched.` |
| `pnpm check:test-path-roots` | 0 | `✅ check-test-path-roots: OK` |
| `pnpm type-check:scripts` | 0 | `tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json`, no diagnostics |
| `pnpm lint:root` | 0 | `✖ 32 problems (0 errors, 32 warnings)` — every warning pre-exists on `origin/main`; the one in a file this PR touches (`VITE_CONFIG_NAME` unused) is at `2dbb49975` too |

**Declared narrowing, and how it is measurable.** `pnpm lint` (`turbo run lint`, every package) was **not** run; `pnpm lint:root` was, and its own config is what defines the population — `eslint . --ignore-pattern 'packages/*/**' --ignore-pattern 'examples/*/**' --ignore-pattern 'apps/*/**' --ignore-pattern 'docs/**'`, which is exactly the region this diff lives in. Type-aware linting is not enabled in `eslint.config.js`, so no file this PR does not touch can change verdict because of it. Everything else the lane asked for was run in full. CI runs the farm.

Self-scan beyond `check:control-bytes`, on the changed files: `grep -naP '[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f\x7f]'` → 0 matches.
